audit_items.proof_trace: Every borrow goes through handle_borrow, which calls try_borrow_asset (line 412) to update the obligation's debt and then immediately calls is_obligation_safe (lines 424-434) on the post-borrow state; assert! at line 434 reverts the transaction if collateral_weighted_value < borrow_weight_weighted_debt_value. The Phase 02c note that borrow interest is refreshed but collateral interest is not (line 406 comment) is intentional: accrued collateral interest only increases collateral value, making the check conservative rather than permissive. Flash-loan borrows use a hot-potato pattern and do not modify obligations.
